sentences: I staple the pages together with the black stapler that sits on my desk.
I refill the stapler with a new strip of staples from the box.
I sharpen the pencil in the electric sharpener until the point is sharp.
I erase the pencil marks with the pink eraser on the end.
I apply correction tape over the typed error on the document that I made earlier.
I highlight the key dates in the report with a yellow highlighter.
I clip the loose papers together with a large binder clip from the drawer.
I fasten the pages with a paper clip before filing them in the folder.
I wrap a rubber band around the stack of index cards on my desk.
I tear off a piece of clear tape from the dispenser to seal the envelope.
I cut the sheet of paper in half with the scissors from the drawer.
I glue the photograph onto the poster board with a glue stick.
I measure the margin with the wooden ruler before drawing a line.
I punch holes in the document with the three-hole punch on the desk.
I calculate the totals on the desk calculator and write them down.
I write a reminder on a sticky note and attach it to the monitor.
I file the index cards in the small box on the shelf.
I print address labels and stick them on the outgoing envelopes one by one.
I place the letter in the envelope and seal the flap with a moistened sponge.
I put a stamp on the envelope and place it in the outbox.
